datasets.title: SQuAD
datasets.description: Stanford Question Answering Dataset (SQuAD) is a reading comprehension dataset consisting of questions posed by crowdworkers on Wikipedia articles.
datasets.readme_text:
# SQuAD
Stanford Question Answering Dataset. Questions and answers derived from Wikipedia articles. Widely used for reading comprehension benchmarks.

datasets.title: MNIST
datasets.description: The MNIST database of handwritten digits. Has a training set of 60,000 examples and a test set of 10,000 examples.
datasets.readme_text:
# MNIST
Handwritten digit image dataset. 28x28 grayscale images labeled 0-9. A classic benchmark for image classification.

datasets.title: Common Voice 11.0
datasets.description: Mozilla Common Voice is an open source, multi-language dataset of voices that anyone can use to train speech-enabled applications.
datasets.readme_text:
# Common Voice 11.0
Crowdsourced multilingual speech dataset from Mozilla. Covers 100+ languages. Audio clips with transcriptions.

datasets.title: Iris
datasets.description: Classic tabular dataset of iris flower measurements for species classification.
datasets.readme_text:
# Iris Dataset
150 samples of iris flowers. Features: sepal length, sepal width, petal length, petal width. Target: species (setosa, versicolor, virginica).
